commentary: The waterfall is compressing: H100 spot now trades at $1.49/hr (Vast.ai) while frontier B200 starts at $3.70/hr, a 2.5x premium that narrows to breakeven on a per-token basis given throughput gains. Hyperscalers extended AI server depreciation to 5-6 years (Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Meta) while Amazon cut it back to 5 in Jan 2025, creating a $176B understatement debate per Burry. CoreWeave's CDS spiked to 50% default odds in July 2026 despite $8.5B investment-grade GPU loan in March—signaling credit markets are repricing both the collateral durability and the revenue stability assumptions embedded in $21B+ of GPU-backed debt.
